{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment is positive (≥0.67), forecast prices should be closer to recent highs to avoid overshooting",
    "When sentiment is negative (≤0.33), forecast prices should be below the current price to allow for expected mean reversion",
    "For EU ETS specifically, model forecasts 3-5 days ahead are often too high relative to true outcomes, requiring 2-3% daily downward adjustment",
    "Sentiment turning from positive to negative requires a faster forecast deceleration than sentiment turning the opposite direction",
    "When price history shows consolidation within a 2-3 euro range, forecasts should narrow to reflect reduced volatility",
    "Model-forecast bias varies systematically with sentiment: positive sentiment causes 1-2% forecast overshoot, negative sentiment causes 0.5-1% forecast undershoot relative to true trajectory",
    "Mean reversion bias is strongest when forecast prices diverge more than 3% from historical mean for 5+ consecutive days"
] }
